title: Board configuration schema
description: Main board configuration including ID, IP address, MAC and references to measurements and packets files.

board_id.description: Unique 32-bit unsigned integer identifier for the board

board_ip.description: IP address string for network communication

mac.description: EUI-48 MAC address of the network interface (e.g. 00:1A:2B:3C:4D:5E)

measurements.description: Array of measurement file paths relative to board directory

packets.description: Array of packet file paths relative to board directory
